newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Golf-Els joins five-way tie for Johnnie Walker Classic lead.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Golf-Els joins five-way tie for Johnnie Walker Classic lead.

text.p: South Africa's Ernie Els stormed up the leaderboard early on the second day of the Johnnie Walker Classic on Friday, joining a five-way tie for the lead.
Els, who was two-under-par overnight, picked up three shots to be five-under by the 12th hole of his second round.

New Zealand's Michael Long also picked up one shot for a share of the lead with India's Arjun Atwal, Anthony Painter of Australia and David Carter of England, all of whom had yet to start their second rounds.
Englishmen Paul Eales and Miles Tunnicliff were on four-under with Australia's Steve Conran midway through their second rounds.
England's Nick Faldo remained on two-under after 11 holes while Bernhard Langer of Germany had picked up one shot to be level with the card after 12 holes.
